title: One Fed, Many Voices: Coordinated Communication vs. Transparent Debate
affiliations: University of Southern California, Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, Independent and Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago

detail.title: One Fed, Many Voices: Coordinated Communication vs. Transparent Debate

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Chicago Working Paper No. 2025-23
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We analyze 481 speeches by FOMC members since 2007, excluding official press conferences. Combining high-frequency financial data with text analysis, we identify monetary policy surprises and measure each speech’s similarity to the Chair’s press conference preceding it. On average, monetary surprises around these speeches have no significant effect on inflation expectations or stock prices. Yet, speeches closely aligned with the Chair’s press conference amplify policy transmission, while less coordinated remarks dilute earlier effects on yields, inflation expectations, and equities. A general equilibrium model with incomplete information rationalizes these findings.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2007年以来FOMC成员的481次演讲（不包括官方新闻发布会），结合高频金融数据和文本分析，发现与主席新闻发布会高度一致的演讲会增强政策传导效果，而不协调的言论则会削弱先前对收益率、通胀预期和股票的影响。
AI.research_question: FOMC成员演讲与主席新闻发布会的一致性如何影响货币政策传导？
AI.motivation: 理解FOMC成员个体言论在货币政策传导中的作用，特别是与主席政策立场一致性对市场反应的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全信息的一般均衡模型
AI.method: 结合高频金融数据与文本分析，分析481次FOMC成员演讲，测量每篇演讲与主席新闻发布会的相似度。
AI.findings: 平均而言，这些演讲周围的货币政策意外对通胀预期或股价没有显著影响。但与主席新闻发布会高度一致的演讲会增强政策传导，而不协调的言论会削弱先前对收益率、通胀预期和股票的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了不完全信息的一般均衡模型来解释这些发现，为理解央行内部沟通协调对政策传导的影响提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行沟通策略提供实证依据，强调了FOMC成员言论与主席立场一致性的重要性，有助于优化货币政策传导效果。

title: Bank Credit Supply and the Unemployment Rate
affiliations: Mount Allison University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Bank Credit Supply and the Unemployment Rate
detail.abstract: There is a strong negative relationship between U.S. bank credit and the unemployment rate since the mid-1980s. In this paper, I ask: Is there a causal connection between changes in the supply of bank credit and the observed fluctuations of the unemployment rate? If so, what are the transmission mechanisms governing such a relationship? To answer these questions, I proceed down two paths. First, I use a bank credit supply measure estimated by Bassett, Chosak, Driscoll, and Zakrajšek (2014) to document the effect that bank credit supply shocks have on the unemployment rate in a VAR model. The results suggest that a one percent contraction in the supply of bank credit leads to a 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate. Moreover, bank credit supply shocks account for about 30% of the volatility in the unemployment rate. Second, I rationalize these results by incorporating a banking sector into an otherwise standard DSGE model with labor search frictions and nominal rigidities. Unlike standard banking models-which restrict banks to intermediaries of pre-accumulated loanable funds-this paper allows banks to finance loans through deposit (i.e., money) creation as described in McLeay, Radia, and Thomas (2014) and Bundesbank (2017). Matched firms must obtain a bank loan to purchase their inputs before production. When banks contract credit, there are fewer funds for firms to purchase their capital and labor inputs and the cost of borrowing rises. This lowers the firms' benefit of matching thereby lowering the benefits of posting a vacancy. As a result, fewer vacancies are posted and labor market tightness falls. In both empirical and model settings, a contraction in bank credit supply leads to a typical recession: GDP, investment, and labor market tightness fall while the cost of external finance and the unemployment rate rise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现银行信贷供给收缩与美国失业率上升之间存在因果关系，信贷供给冲击可解释约30%的失业率波动。
AI.research_question: 银行信贷供给变化与失业率波动之间是否存在因果关系？这种关系的传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 自1980年代中期以来，美国银行信贷与失业率之间存在强烈的负相关关系，需要探究这种关系的因果性和传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合银行部门的标准DSGE模型，包含劳动力搜寻摩擦和名义刚性，区别于传统银行中介模型，允许银行通过存款创造来融资。
AI.method: 使用VAR模型分析银行信贷供给冲击对失业率的影响，并构建包含银行部门的DSGE模型进行理论解释。
AI.findings: 银行信贷供给收缩1%会导致失业率上升0.3个百分点；信贷供给冲击可解释约30%的失业率波动；信贷收缩导致典型衰退特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 将银行信贷创造机制纳入标准宏观模型，揭示了信贷供给通过影响企业融资成本进而影响劳动力市场的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解信贷市场与劳动力市场联动提供了实证和理论依据，有助于制定更有效的宏观经济政策。

title: Prenatal Program Participation and Child Reading Achievement: Evidence from the PSID Child Development Supplement (PSID Dataset)

detail.title: Prenatal Program Participation and Child Reading Achievement: Evidence from the PSID Child Development Supplement (PSID Dataset)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No personal or financial relationships influenced the conduct or interpretation of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available, de-identified secondary data from the PSID Child Development Supplement. No human subjects were recruited, and no institutional ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether prenatal participation in two U.S. safety-net programs—the Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) nutrition program and Aid to Families with Dependent Children (AFDC)—is associated with children’s later reading achievement. Using nationally representative data from the PSID Child Development Supplement (analytic N=1,845), we estimate multiple regression models controlling for child age, family income, low birth weight, and home learning environment. We find that WIC and AFDC participants exhibit lower reading scores on average; however, these negative coefficients likely reflect underlying socioeconomic disadvantage rather than causal effects of the programs. Among covariates, home environment quality and family income are the strongest positive predictors of reading outcomes. The results highlight the centrality of postnatal home learning conditions in shaping cognitive development and suggest that prenatal support programs may be more effective when integrated with sustained early-learning interventions. This study contributes observational evidence on the long-term correlates of prenatal public assistance using a policy-relevant, nationally representative dataset.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨产前参与WIC营养计划和AFDC福利项目是否与儿童后期阅读成绩相关。使用PSID全国代表性数据发现，虽然项目参与者阅读分数较低，但这主要反映社会经济劣势而非项目因果效应。家庭学习环境和收入是阅读成绩的最强预测因素。
AI.research_question: 产前参与WIC营养计划和AFDC福利项目是否与儿童后期阅读成绩相关？
AI.motivation: 研究产前公共援助项目对儿童长期认知发展的影响，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于儿童发展理论和公共政策评估框架，关注社会经济因素与认知发展的关系。
AI.method: 使用PSID儿童发展补充调查的全国代表性数据（N=1,845），采用多元回归模型控制儿童年龄、家庭收入、低出生体重和家庭学习环境等因素。
AI.findings: WIC和AFDC参与者平均阅读分数较低，但负向系数主要反映社会经济劣势而非项目因果效应。家庭环境质量和家庭收入是阅读成绩的最强正向预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调产后家庭学习条件在认知发展中的核心作用，为儿童发展理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议产前支持项目应与持续早期学习干预相结合，为公共援助政策优化提供观察性证据。

title: Beyond Arrow's Impossibility: A Formal Proof that Negative Vote Satisfies all Five Fairness Criteria

detail.title: Beyond Arrow's Impossibility: A Formal Proof that Negative Vote Satisfies all Five Fairness Criteria
detail.abstract: Arrow's Impossibility Theorem demonstrates that no ranked voting system can simultaneously satisfy five desirable fairness criteria. This working paper proves that a binary directional choice mechanism-the Negative Vote-satisfies all five conditions. Under this system, voters may form complete ordinal rankings but then choose whether to cast a vote FOR their top-ranked candidate or AGAINST their bottom-ranked candidate. This two-stage process provides sufficient information to escape Arrow's constraints without requiring voters to quantify preference magnitudes. The proof demonstrates that Unrestricted Domain, Non-Dictatorship, Pareto Efficiency, Independence of Irrelevant Alternatives, and Collective Rationality are all satisfied.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一种二元定向选择机制——负面投票系统——能够同时满足阿罗不可能定理中的所有五个公平性条件，突破了该定理的限制。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一种投票机制能够同时满足阿罗不可能定理中的所有五个公平性条件？
AI.motivation: 阿罗不可能定理表明传统排名投票系统无法同时满足五个理想的公平标准，这促使研究者寻找新的投票机制来突破这一限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于阿罗不可能定理的五个公平性条件：无限制域、非独裁性、帕累托效率、无关选项独立性和集体理性。
AI.method: 采用二元定向选择机制（负面投票系统），允许选民形成完整排名后选择投赞成票给最高排名候选人或反对票给最低排名候选人。
AI.findings: 负面投票系统能够同时满足阿罗不可能定理的所有五个公平性条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明存在投票机制能够突破阿罗不可能定理的限制，为投票理论提供了新的理论可能性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实际可行的投票方案，既不需要选民量化偏好强度，又能确保公平性，具有实际应用价值。

title: The Boundary Principle: Why Transformation Follows the Same Four Stages in Minds, Machines, and Matter

detail.title: The Boundary Principle: Why Transformation Follows the Same Four Stages in Minds, Machines, and Matter
detail.abstract: Transformation is typically treated as a domain-specific process: psychologists analyze identity crises, AI researchers study catastrophic forgetting, and physicists investigate the breakdown of classical models. This paper argues that these events reflect a single architectural mechanism-the Boundary Principle. The Principle proposes that coherent systems, when pushed to the limits of their predictive frameworks, undergo a four-stage sequence of Expansion, Suspension, Confrontation, and Integration. This sequence is first illustrated through intuitive cases in psychology and machine learning and then demonstrated rigorously through mathematical and physical invariants: the Golden Ratio φ, the exponential base e, π, Planck's constant h, and the Feigenbaum constants δ and α. Each invariant becomes visible only through boundary-induced instability, indicating that transformation follows a universal structural pattern. The Boundary Principle generates falsifiable predictions across AI, neuroscience, immunology, and psychology, positioning it as a candidate for a general law governing how systems reveal deeper invariants at the edge of coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了边界原则，认为当系统达到其预测框架的极限时，会经历扩展、暂停、对抗和整合四个阶段的转变过程，这一机制在不同领域（心理学、AI、物理学）具有普适性。
AI.research_question: 不同领域中的转变过程是否遵循统一的架构机制？
AI.motivation: 当前各领域对转变过程的研究相互隔离，缺乏统一的理论框架来解释跨领域的转变现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边界原则：系统在达到预测框架极限时经历的四阶段转变序列（扩展、暂停、对抗、整合）。
AI.method: 通过心理学和机器学习的直观案例进行说明，然后通过数学和物理不变量（黄金比例φ、自然常数e、π、普朗克常数h、费根鲍姆常数δ和α）进行严格证明。
AI.findings: 边界诱导的不稳定性揭示了各种数学和物理不变量，表明转变遵循普遍的结构模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨领域的统一转变理论框架，将边界原则定位为系统在相干性边缘揭示更深层不变量的通用法则。
AI.practical_contributions: 边界原则在AI、神经科学、免疫学和心理学等领域产生了可证伪的预测，具有广泛的应用价值。

title: SRE in the Law of Technological Risk: Reliability and responsibility
affiliations: University of Buenos Aires (UBA) - Universidad de Buenos Aires

detail.title: SRE in the Law of Technological Risk: Reliability and responsibility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The research was conducted independently without any financial or institutional influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based solely on documentary analysis of regulatory and technical sources. No human participants, patients, or case studies were involved, and therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords: Evidence Standards for Logs and Metrics

detail.abstract:
Modern automated systems evolve continuously through deployment pipelines, data-driven adjustments and learning models whose internal behaviour can shift in ways that escape occasional inspection. Traditional legal supervision, built around documents and ex-post reviews, struggles to track risks that emerge at this operational layer. This paper argues for a framework of oversight grounded in technical literacy, drawing on early regulatory experiences with algorithmic audits, AI impact assessments and risk-based supervision. The proposal emphasises practical capacities: traceable data governance, defensible evidence from logs and metrics, structured inspection routines and controlled testing environments. These elements support a form of reliability understood not as a guarantee but as a disciplined organisational habit. The paper suggests how legal institutions can incorporate such practices and how insights from Site Reliability Engineering can inform a more realistic standard of responsibility in automated environments.

Author’s archived copy available at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17363577

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个基于技术素养的自动化系统监管框架，强调可追溯的数据治理、可辩护的证据收集、结构化检查程序和受控测试环境，以支持将可靠性视为组织习惯而非保证的监管理念。
AI.research_question: 如何在自动化系统持续演进的背景下，建立有效的监管框架来跟踪和管控运营层面的风险？
AI.motivation: 传统法律监管基于文档和事后审查，难以跟踪自动化系统在运营层面出现的风险，需要新的监管方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术素养监管框架，借鉴算法审计、AI影响评估和基于风险的监管经验。
AI.method: 提出基于实际能力的监管框架，包括可追溯数据治理、日志和指标证据、结构化检查程序和受控测试环境。
AI.findings: 通过技术素养监管框架，可以将可靠性理解为一种有纪律的组织习惯，而非绝对保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将站点可靠性工程的见解引入法律监管领域，为自动化环境中的责任标准提供更现实的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律机构提供可操作的具体实践，帮助其将技术素养监管纳入现有监管体系。

title: Determinants of Rwanda's International Trade Growth, 2020-2024: A Bilateral Partner × Year Panel Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Determinants of Rwanda's International Trade Growth, 2020-2024: A Bilateral Partner × Year Panel Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper examines the drivers of Rwanda's export growth over the period 2020-2025 using a bilateral partner × year panel. Using annual merchandise exports from UN Comtrade and partner-level macroeconomic variables from the World Bank WDI, I estimate partner fixedeffects models with year fixed effects and cluster-robust standard errors to isolate time-varying determinants of Rwanda's export behavior. I also consider dynamic specifications (lagged exports) estimated via system GMM to account for persistence and endogeneity. The paper discusses implications for trade policy and regional integration, with specific attention to trade concentration (top partners such as UAE and DRC) and commodity composition (gold, coffee, tea, base metals). Data sources, reproducible R code, and pre-analysis plans are provided to maximize transparency and replicability.

AI.tldr: 本文使用2020-2025年双边伙伴×年份面板数据，通过固定效应模型和系统GMM方法分析卢旺达出口增长的决定因素，重点关注贸易集中度和商品构成，并为贸易政策和区域一体化提供政策建议。
AI.research_question: 卢旺达出口增长的决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解卢旺达出口增长的驱动因素，为贸易政策和区域一体化提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论，特别是出口决定因素和贸易伙伴关系理论。
AI.method: 使用UN Comtrade的年度商品出口数据和世界银行WDI的宏观经济变量，构建双边伙伴×年份面板数据，采用伙伴固定效应模型和年份固定效应，以及系统GMM方法处理持续性和内生性问题。
AI.findings: 分析了贸易集中度（主要伙伴如阿联酋和刚果民主共和国）和商品构成（黄金、咖啡、茶叶、贱金属）对卢旺达出口的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家出口决定因素研究提供了新的实证证据，特别是对小国经济体的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卢旺达的贸易政策和区域一体化战略提供具体建议，提高政策制定的透明度和可复制性。

title: Analysis of Property Bubbles in Major Indonesian Cities (2010–2025): A Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) Approach
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Analysis of Property Bubbles in Major Indonesian Cities (2010–2025): A Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) Approach

declarations.ethicsApproval: I, the undersigned, hereby declare that the research thesis entitled “Analysis of Property Bubbles in Major Indonesian Cities (2010–2025): A Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) Approach” is an entirely independent work conducted by myself. This research was not funded, supervised, or formally affiliated with any university, institution, or organization. All data, analyses, and interpretations presented in this study are based on publicly available information, official statistical publications, and the author’s independent analysis. Every source of information and literature used in this work has been properly acknowledged and cited according to academic standards. The purpose of this research is to contribute to the academic discussion on housing market dynamics, speculative behavior, and macroeconomic stability in emerging economies, particularly Indonesia. I take full responsibility for the integrity, originality, and accuracy of the content within this work. This thesis is submitted for academic review and consideration as an independent scholarly contribution

detail.abstract:
This study investigates the existence and dynamics of property price bubbles in major Indonesian cities from 2010 to 2025 using a Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) regression approach. The research aims to identify the macroeconomic and financial factors influencing rapid housing price growth, including interest rates, GDP per capita, credit expansion, and urban population growth.

The 2SLS model is employed to address endogeneity between property prices and credit variables, ensuring unbiased parameter estimation. Results indicate significant evidence of speculative bubbles during periods of low interest rates and high credit growth, particularly in Jakarta, Surabaya, and Medan.

The findings highlight the critical role of monetary policy and banking regulation in mitigating systemic risks within Indonesia’s real estate sector. This study contributes to the empirical understanding of asset price bubbles in emerging markets and provides policy recommendations for sustainable housing market development.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用两阶段最小二乘法(2SLS)回归方法，分析了2010-2025年印尼主要城市房地产价格泡沫的存在和动态，发现低利率和高信贷增长时期存在显著的投机泡沫，特别是在雅加达、泗水和棉兰。
AI.research_question: 印尼主要城市是否存在房地产价格泡沫？影响房价快速增长的宏观经济和金融因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 研究印尼房地产市场的泡沫现象，为政策制定者提供管理系统性风险的理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产价格泡沫理论、房地产经济学、宏观经济学理论
AI.method: 两阶段最小二乘法(2SLS)回归，用于解决房地产价格与信贷变量之间的内生性问题
AI.findings: 在低利率和高信贷增长时期存在显著的投机泡沫，特别是在雅加达、泗水和棉兰等主要城市
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了新兴市场资产价格泡沫的实证研究，提供了处理内生性问题的计量方法应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策和银行监管提供政策建议，促进印尼房地产市场的可持续发展

title: The Energy of the Anthropocene
affiliations: The New School

detail.title: The Energy of the Anthropocene
detail.abstract: The planet is in trouble. Much of this is the result of how we produce and use energy. As Vaclav Smil has made very clear, neither our economy nor our civilization could exist without energy.[1] That said, we must take a careful look at our relationship with energy to ensure it does not harm our planetary home. It is the only one we have. Cherish it we must.

AI.tldr: 本文强调能源生产和使用对地球环境的影响，呼吁重新审视人类与能源的关系以保护地球家园。
AI.research_question: 如何重新审视和调整人类与能源的关系以保护地球环境？
AI.motivation: 地球环境面临严重威胁，而能源的生产和使用是主要原因之一，需要确保能源利用不损害我们唯一的行星家园。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Vaclav Smil的能源理论，强调能源对经济和文明的基础性作用。
AI.method: 概念性分析和理论探讨。
AI.findings: 能源对人类社会至关重要，但当前的能源使用模式正在损害地球环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对能源与环境关系的理论认识，强调可持续发展的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和公众提供了重新思考能源使用方式的实践指导，促进环境保护意识的提升。

title: A Multi-Agent Market Simulation with Fundamental and Behavioural Dynamics
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Multi-Agent Market Simulation with Fundamental and Behavioural Dynamics
detail.abstract: Financial markets exhibit complex behaviours-fat-tailed return distributions, volatility clustering, and prolonged deviations from fundamental values-that traditional equilibrium models fail to explain fully. This study develops a multi-agent market simulation in which heterogeneous traders interact within a single synthetic equity market. Agents employ distinct strategies-trend-following, mean-reversion, and fundamental value investing-while the asset's intrinsic value evolves through a geometric Brownian motion process with optional company feedback. Prices emerge endogenously from a supply-demand clearing mechanism that aggregates individual orders. The model reproduces several key stylized facts of fundamental markets, including heavytailed log-return distributions (kurtosis 10.6), weak short-term autocorrelation, and persistent volatility clustering. Controlled experiments isolating agent types reveal that trendfollowers amplify volatility and tail risk, mean-reverting agents stabilize price dynamics, and fundamental traders anchor long-term equilibrium. Policy simulations show that microstructural interventions-such as order delays ("speed bumps") and incentives for more extended holding periods-can meaningfully reduce speculative volatility and tail events without eliminating market efficiency. Overall, the framework demonstrates how realistic market dynamics can arise from the interaction of simple behavioural heuristics. It provides a transparent, extensible platform for analyzing the systemic effects of trading behaviour and market regulation in a controlled, data-rich environment. This work was conducted as part of an independent research project under the mentorship of Anuj Awasthi , Vice President of Operations at CGIF, whose insights into market microstructure and behavioural trading dynamics provided valuable guidance during model development.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个多智能体市场模拟，通过异质交易者的互动重现了金融市场的关键特征，包括厚尾收益分布、波动率聚集等，并分析了不同交易策略对市场的影响以及政策干预的效果。
AI.research_question: 异质交易者如何通过简单的行为启发式互动产生复杂的市场动态？不同交易策略和政策干预对市场稳定性和效率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统均衡模型无法完全解释金融市场中观察到的复杂行为特征，如厚尾收益分布、波动率聚集和价格偏离基本面等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多智能体模拟和行为金融学理论，构建异质交易者模型，包括趋势跟随、均值回归和基本面投资策略。
AI.method: 开发多智能体市场模拟，交易者采用不同策略在单一合成股票市场中互动，资产内在价值通过几何布朗运动演化，价格通过供需清算机制内生形成。
AI.findings: 模型成功重现了真实市场的关键特征；趋势跟随者放大波动性和尾部风险，均值回归交易者稳定价格动态，基本面交易者锚定长期均衡；订单延迟和长期持有激励等政策干预可有效降低投机性波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了简单行为启发式互动如何产生复杂市场动态，为理解市场微观结构和行为交易动态提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析交易行为和市场监管的系统性效应提供了透明、可扩展的平台，有助于设计更有效的市场稳定政策。

title: Sustainability-linked Loans and Financial Performance
affiliations: Boston University - Questrom School of Business

detail.title: Sustainability-linked Loans and Financial Performance
detail.abstract: Using a sample of bank loans, I find that firms borrowing sustainability-linked loans (SLLs) experience credit rating upgrades and higher post-borrowing equity returns relative to firms borrowing conventional loans. Channel tests then indicate that these effects arise primarily through reduced financing costs channels. To rationalize the findings, I develop a model in which firms choose between SLLs and conventional loans: SLLs offer lower coupons conditional on meeting sustainability targets but incur additional borrowing and compliance costs. The model shows that the financing-cost reduction alone is sufficient to generate the observed credit improvements and equity outperformance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，企业借入可持续发展挂钩贷款（SLLs）相比传统贷款，会获得信用评级提升和更高的借款后股票回报。这些效应主要通过降低融资成本渠道实现。模型表明仅融资成本降低就足以产生观察到的信用改善和股票表现优异。
AI.research_question: 可持续发展挂钩贷款（SLLs）如何影响借款企业的信用评级和股票表现？
AI.motivation: 研究SLLs对借款企业财务表现的影响机制，特别是通过融资成本渠道的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建企业选择SLLs与传统贷款的决策模型，SLLs在满足可持续目标时提供较低票息但需承担额外借款和合规成本
AI.method: 使用银行贷款样本进行实证分析，包括渠道检验和理论模型构建
AI.findings: 借入SLLs的企业经历信用评级提升和更高的借款后股票回报，这些效应主要通过降低融资成本渠道产生
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了企业贷款选择的理论模型，证明融资成本降低足以解释SLLs带来的信用改善和股票表现优异
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业选择贷款类型提供决策依据，帮助理解SLLs的经济效益机制

title: Deprivation and the Leisure-Consumption Choice
affiliations: Heriot-Watt University

detail.title: Deprivation and the Leisure-Consumption Choice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is purely theoretical and has not made use of any data sources, or inputs by patients or other participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords: S-Shaped Cardinal Utility includes Increasing Marginal Utility Expressing Deprivation
Dysfunctional Poverty Causes Involuntary Unemployment and Disequilibrium

detail.abstract:
The separability rule is unable to distinguish between two commodities fulfilling the same need (multiplicative utilities) and their fulfilling different needs (additive utilities), if each utility specifies only diminishing marginal utility An S-shaped cardinal utility, bounded below and above, represents the individual’s experience of fulfilment of a need by a commodity – deprivation (increasing marginal utility (MU)), subsistence, sufficiency, and either satiation at finite consumption with the possibility of surfeit, or satiation at infinite consumption.
Functional forms are derived from a utility function for leisure and consumption, created by adding two normal cumulative distribution functions, with satiation at infinity, the parameters of each representing subsistence and intensity-of-need. The indifference curve map, demand and Engels curve diagrams are explored.

The main outcomes:
• Concave- (dysfunctional poverty) and convex-to-the-origin indifference curves are separated by a straight-line indifference curve, (an absolute poverty line), with slope defined by the relative-intensities-of-need.
• Budget movements on the indifference curve map reveal corner solutions and disequilibrium associated with dysfunctional poverty.
• The derived functional forms are functions of only the real wage rate and the endowment of unearned consumption.
• The derived functional form diagrams display: involuntary unemployment, disjointed curves, sticky wages and prices, wage- and price-elasticity associated with deprivation of a need, inferior normal and inferior-Giffen responses, and envelope curves.
• The co-incidence of the wage rate equalling the slope of the straight-line indifference curve and the endowment equalling its intercept, where both labour and consumption are very wage-, price- and endowment-elastic, leads to a highly unstable situation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于S形基数效用函数的理论框架，能够区分满足相同需求（乘法效用）和不同需求（加法效用）的商品。通过结合两个正态累积分布函数构建休闲与消费的效用函数，揭示了贫困线、角点解、非自愿失业等经济现象。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够区分商品满足相同需求与不同需求的效用理论框架，并解释贫困、失业等经济现象？
AI.motivation: 传统可分性规则无法区分满足相同需求和不同需求的商品，需要开发新的效用函数形式来更好地描述个体需求满足的完整过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: S形基数效用理论、边际效用递减理论、需求层次理论、贫困线理论
AI.method: 构建基于两个正态累积分布函数的效用函数，分析无差异曲线图、需求曲线和恩格尔曲线
AI.findings: 发现了凹形和凸形无差异曲线的分离、角点解、非自愿失业、工资粘性、吉芬商品等现象，并识别了高度不稳定的经济状态
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的效用函数形式，能够更准确地描述需求满足过程，为贫困和失业理论提供了新的微观基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别贫困线、理解劳动力市场失灵、制定反贫困政策提供了理论依据

title: The Alwadhi Power-Law of Diamond Pricing: A Universal Mathematical Framework for Gemstone Valuation
affiliations: Maison Alwadhi ®

detail.title: The Alwadhi Power-Law of Diamond Pricing: A Universal Mathematical Framework for Gemstone Valuation
detail.abstract: We establish the first universal mathematical law for diamond pricing, addressing a fundamental gap in economic theory that has persisted since the formalization of commodity markets. The Alwadhi Power-Law states that diamond price scales with carat weight according to P=B ⋅W α ⋅C s ⋅∏ M q , where the critical exponent α=1.725 ± 0.012 emerges from the intersection of geological scarcity distributions, fractal formation processes, and market equilibrium dynamics. Through analysis of 1.2 million transaction records across global markets (2019-2024) and rigorous theoretical derivation from first principles, we demonstrate that this law represents a fundamental economic relationship analogous to gravity in physics or allometric scaling in biology. The power-law exponent sits precisely at the boundary between normal market behavior (α <2) and bubble dynamics (α >2), suggesting an efficient market equilibrium shaped by natural constraints. Empirical validation yields R 2 =0.9874 (p<10-15) with shape coefficients exhibiting remarkable stability across geographic markets (coefficient of variation ¿ 0.03). The law's mathematical structure enables closed-form solutions for derivative pricing, portfolio optimization, and risk assessment while maintaining computational efficiency three orders of magnitude superior to machine learning alternatives. This work not only provides the diamond industry with its first scientific pricing framework but also contributes to the broader understanding of power laws in economic systems, demonstrating how physical constraints and market forces combine to produce universal scaling relationships in commodity valuation.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次建立了钻石定价的普遍数学定律——Alwadhi幂律，揭示了钻石价格与克拉重量之间的幂律关系，指数α=1.725±0.012，代表了地质稀缺性、分形形成过程和市场均衡动态的交叉点。
AI.research_question: 钻石定价是否存在普遍数学定律？
AI.motivation: 解决自商品市场形式化以来经济理论中存在的根本性空白，为钻石行业提供首个科学定价框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地质稀缺分布、分形形成过程和市场均衡动态的交叉理论框架。
AI.method: 分析2019-2024年全球市场120万条交易记录，并从第一原理进行严格理论推导。
AI.findings: 发现钻石价格与克拉重量遵循幂律关系P=B⋅W^α⋅C_s⋅∏M_q，其中α=1.725±0.012，R²=0.9874(p<10^-15)，且形状系数在地理市场中表现出显著稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济系统中的幂律提供了更广泛的理解，展示了物理约束和市场力量如何结合产生商品估值的普遍标度关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为钻石行业提供首个科学定价框架，其数学结构支持衍生品定价、投资组合优化和风险评估的封闭形式解，计算效率比机器学习替代方案高三个数量级。

title: Why Financial Governance Fails on Transportation Management

detail.title: Why Financial Governance Fails on Transportation Management
detail.abstract: This paper examines the global allocation of private capital between electric vehicles (EVs) and public transit, arguing that current investment patterns fundamentally undermine genuine decarbonization while espousing climate action rhetoric. Drawing on recent data (2021-2024) from BloombergNEF, the IEA, the ICCT, and the ITF, it is shown that while EVs can reduce emissions per vehicle, a universal rollout of private EVs would exceed the world's remaining carbon budget. Public transit, in contrast, delivers far higher energy, spatial, and material efficiency. The paper situates the cause of this mis-allocation within the structure of modern finance, traces this logical fallacy into the classrooms of the next generation of engineers and leaders, and concludes that only by staunchly rejecting this irrational approach and doing that which is necessary to redirect investment toward collective, electrified transit, can transport decarbonization remain compatible with a 2 °C world.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了私人资本在电动汽车和公共交通之间的全球分配模式，指出当前投资模式在宣扬气候行动的同时实际上破坏了真正的脱碳进程。研究表明，虽然电动汽车能减少单车排放，但全面推广私人电动汽车将超出全球剩余碳预算，而公共交通在能源、空间和材料效率方面远胜一筹。
AI.research_question: 私人资本在电动汽车与公共交通之间的投资分配如何影响交通脱碳的可行性？
AI.motivation: 当前投资模式表面上支持气候行动，但实际上通过过度投资私人电动汽车而破坏了真正的脱碳目标，需要揭示这种投资错配的根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于现代金融结构理论，分析投资决策中的逻辑谬误及其在工程和管理教育中的传播。
AI.method: 使用BloombergNEF、IEA、ICCT和ITF的2021-2024年数据进行实证分析，比较电动汽车和公共交通的碳预算影响及效率指标。
AI.findings: 私人电动汽车的全面推广将超出全球剩余碳预算，而公共交通在能源、空间和材料效率方面具有显著优势，但当前投资模式严重偏向电动汽车。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了现代金融结构如何导致投资决策与气候目标脱节，并分析了这种逻辑谬误在教育体系中的传播机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了重新定向投资方向的依据，强调必须将资本转向集体电动化公共交通，以实现2°C气候目标。

title: The Essence of Committed Leadership: Vision, Action, and Influence

detail.title: The Essence of Committed Leadership: Vision, Action, and Influence
detail.abstract: Committed leadership is a critical factor in driving organizational success, fostering team cohesion, and inspiring positive influence. This study explores the essential qualities that define a committed leader, emphasizing self-discipline, ethical integrity, vision, and the ability to inspire others. Drawing on the insights of renowned thought leaders such as Ray Kroc, John C. Maxwell, Abraham Lincoln, and John Wooden, it highlights five key dimensions of effective leadership: the standards leaders set for themselves, clarity of vision and example-based guidance, unwavering commitment to translating promises into results, willingness to prioritize collective goals over personal interests, and the capacity to influence and empower others. By examining these principles, the study underscores that leadership extends beyond formal titles or authority; it is manifested in action, consistency, and the transformative impact one leader can have on individuals and organizations. The findings provide a framework for understanding and cultivating leadership that is both principled and results-driven, offering practical insights for current and aspiring leaders seeking to create sustainable, positive change.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了承诺型领导力的核心品质，包括自律、道德诚信、愿景和激励能力，基于知名思想领袖的见解提出了有效领导的五个关键维度，强调领导力体现在行动、一致性和变革性影响上。
AI.research_question: 承诺型领导力的核心品质是什么？如何培养既能坚持原则又能驱动结果的领导力？
AI.motivation: 承诺型领导力是推动组织成功、促进团队凝聚力和激发积极影响的关键因素，需要深入理解其本质特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ray Kroc、John C. Maxwell、Abraham Lincoln和John Wooden等思想领袖的领导理论，构建了承诺型领导力的理论框架。
AI.method: 文献分析和思想领袖见解的整合研究，通过案例和原则分析来探讨领导力品质。
AI.findings: 识别了有效领导的五个关键维度：自我标准设定、愿景清晰与榜样引导、承诺转化为结果、集体目标优先于个人利益、影响和赋能他人的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了承诺型领导力的多维理论框架，深化了对领导力本质的理解，超越了传统权威和头衔的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前和未来领导者提供了培养原则性与结果导向领导力的实用框架，有助于创造可持续的积极变革。

title: Globalization, Growth, and Energy Imports in Hungary: Implications for ESG and Sustainability Policy from a Threshold ARDL Analysis
affiliations: University of Pécs - Faculty of Business and Economics and University of Pécs

detail.title: Globalization, Growth, and Energy Imports in Hungary: Implications for ESG and Sustainability Policy from a Threshold ARDL Analysis
detail.abstract: As a post-transition economy, Hungary faces persistent challenges in reconciling economic growth with environmental sustainability amid the pressures of globalization and increasing energy dependence. While extensive research has explored the Environmental Kuznets Curve (EKC) and the environmental consequences of globalization, limited attention has been paid to the interaction between nonlinear growth dynamics and structural factors such as energy imports and European Union (EU) integration. This study addresses this gap by applying a multiple-threshold autoregressive distributed lag (MT-ARDL) model to assess the dynamic impacts of globalization, economic growth, and energy imports on Hungary's ecological footprint (EFP). Using annual data from 1970 to 2023, the analysis incorporates structural break unit root tests, threshold ARDL bounds testing, and frequency domain Granger causality to ensure methodological robustness. The findings indicate that environmental degradation is most severe during low-growth periods, whereas medium-and high-growth phases are associated with relative decoupling, driven by increased renewable energy use, improved energy efficiency and alignment with EU environmental regulations. Notably, energy imports aggravated environmental degradation during moderate growth but tended to mitigate ecological pressure under high-growth conditions, likely due to technological innovation and energy diversification. Globalization exerts a positive long-run influence by enhancing institutional quality and facilitating green technology transfer. These results have important implications for aligning Hungary's development trajectory with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) objectives, highlighting the need for growth-sensitive 1 energy strategies, deeper regional integration, and strengthened climate governance to support a sustainable transition.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用MT-ARDL模型分析匈牙利1970-2023年数据，发现环境退化在低增长期最严重，中高增长期因可再生能源使用、能效提升和欧盟法规而相对脱钩。能源进口在中等增长期加剧环境退化，但在高增长期因技术创新和能源多样化而缓解。全球化通过提升制度质量和绿色技术转移产生积极影响。
AI.research_question: 全球化、经济增长和能源进口如何动态影响匈牙利的生态足迹？非线性增长动态与结构因素（如能源进口和欧盟一体化）之间的相互作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 作为后转型经济体，匈牙利面临经济增长与环境可持续性协调的持续挑战。虽然已有大量研究探讨环境库兹涅茨曲线和全球化的环境影响，但对非线性增长动态与结构因素相互作用的关注有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境库兹涅茨曲线(EKC)、全球化理论、能源进口与可持续发展理论、欧盟一体化影响理论
AI.method: 使用多阈值自回归分布滞后(MT-ARDL)模型，结合结构断点单位根检验、阈值ARDL边界检验和频域格兰杰因果关系分析，使用1970-2023年年度数据
AI.findings: 1) 环境退化在低增长期最严重，中高增长期相对脱钩；2) 能源进口在中等增长期加剧环境退化，但在高增长期缓解生态压力；3) 全球化通过提升制度质量和绿色技术转移产生积极长期影响
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了环境库兹涅茨曲线理论，揭示了非线性增长动态与结构因素的相互作用机制，为后转型经济体可持续发展提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为匈牙利制定增长敏感型能源战略、深化区域一体化、加强气候治理提供政策建议，支持其实现ESG目标和可持续转型

title: Monetary Policy and Anomalies
affiliations: CUNY Baruch College, Boston University - Questrom School of Business and Monash University - Department of Banking and Finance

detail.title: Monetary Policy and Anomalies
detail.abstract: We show that long-short anomaly portfolios exhibit significantly negative returns on monetary policy announcement days, in contrast to positive returns on other days. This effect is persistent and especially pronounced during periods of accommodative monetary policy. To quantitatively account for these findings, we develop a model in which monetary policy announcements reveal the Fed’s interest rate target, generating discount rate shocks. Heterogeneity in the sensitivity of stock valuations to these shocks gives rise to cross-sectional differences in announcement-day risk compensation. This sensitivity depends endogenously on anomaly signals: overpriced stocks have longer duration, are more exposed to interest rate risk, and therefore require higher expected returns than underpriced stocks. Lower interest rate environments reinforce this mechanism by increasing valuation sensitivity, leading to more negative anomaly portfolio returns.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多空异象投资组合在货币政策宣布日呈现显著负收益，而在其他日期为正收益。这种效应在宽松货币政策期间尤为明显。作者建立了一个模型来解释这一现象：货币政策宣布通过揭示美联储利率目标产生贴现率冲击，不同股票对这些冲击的敏感性差异导致了横截面上的风险补偿差异。
AI.research_question: 货币政策宣布如何影响多空异象投资组合的收益表现？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策宣布对股票市场异象收益的时变影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 贴现率冲击模型、利率风险暴露理论、股票估值敏感性
AI.method: 理论模型构建与实证检验相结合的方法
AI.findings: 多空异象投资组合在货币政策宣布日呈现显著负收益，这种效应在宽松货币政策期间更加明显
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了货币政策宣布通过贴现率冲击影响异象收益的理论机制，解释了估值敏感性在其中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在货币政策宣布期间管理异象投资组合风险提供了理论指导

title: Equivalence of Lindahl Prices and Core in a Collective Choice Problem
affiliations: Beijing Jiaotong University - School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Equivalence of Lindahl Prices and Core in a Collective Choice Problem

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China (Nos. 72271016 and 72571022), the Beijing Natural Science Foundation (No. Z220001).

detail.abstract: We study the collective choice problem examined by Delacrétaz et al. (2025), a framework that encompasses the allocation of both public and private goods as special cases and in which Lindahl prices are shown to exist and be efficient. We model the problem as a cooperative game and establish an equivalence between Lindahl prices and the core: every Lindahl price vector supports a core allocation, and every core allocation admits at least one corresponding Lindahl price vector. Moreover, distinct Lindahl prices supporting the same core allocation assign identical prices to all efficient alternatives. This result resembles a classical core-equivalence theorem but is derived without relying on replication or continuum-player settings. It further shows that, in collective choice problems, Lindahl prices are not only individually rational and socially efficient but also collectively rational. We also extend the single-firm setting in Delacrétaz et al. (2025) to a multi-firm setting and show that the equivalence between Lindahl prices and the core continues to hold. We further examine the connection between the VCG mechanism, prominent under incomplete information, and the core. We show that the core being a singleton is the necessary and sufficient condition for each of the following: (i) the VCG mechanism satisfies budget balance; and (ii) the VCG transfers lie in the core. This condition is shown to hold in shortage markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了集体选择问题，建立了Lindahl价格与核心的等价关系：每个Lindahl价格向量都支持一个核心分配，每个核心分配都至少对应一个Lindahl价格向量。同时证明了在多企业设置下这种等价关系仍然成立，并探讨了VCG机制与核心的联系。
AI.research_question: 在集体选择问题中，Lindahl价格与核心分配之间是否存在等价关系？在多企业设置下这种关系是否仍然成立？VCG机制与核心之间有何联系？
AI.motivation: Delacrétaz等人(2025)研究了包含公共品和私人物品分配的特殊情况的集体选择问题，证明了Lindahl价格的存在性和效率性。本文旨在进一步探讨Lindahl价格与核心的深层关系，并扩展到多企业设置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合作博弈理论、Lindahl定价理论、核心理论、VCG机制设计理论
AI.method: 理论建模和证明方法，将集体选择问题建模为合作博弈，建立Lindahl价格与核心的等价关系，并扩展到多企业设置
AI.findings: 1. Lindahl价格与核心分配存在等价关系；2. 在多企业设置下这种等价关系仍然成立；3. 核心为单点是VCG机制满足预算平衡和VCG转移支付位于核心的充要条件；4. 这种条件在短缺市场中成立
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了Lindahl价格与核心的等价关系，无需依赖复制或连续参与者设置；2. 证明了Lindahl价格在集体选择问题中具有集体理性；3. 扩展了单企业设置到多企业设置；4. 建立了VCG机制与核心的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为集体决策机制设计提供了理论指导，特别是在公共品供给、资源分配和机制设计方面，有助于设计更有效的集体选择机制

title: Beveridge Meets Phillips: Asset Pricing Implications *
affiliations: Xiamen University, Xiamen University and Institue for Financial and Accounting Studies, Xiamen University

detail.title: Beveridge Meets Phillips: Asset Pricing Implications *
detail.abstract: We extend a general equilibrium search model with labor heterogeneity and consumption price shocks for matching observed equity premium variability. We derive the labor market tightness factor from the Beveridge curve-the relationship between vacancies and unemployment-and derive the inflation factor from the Phillips curve-the association between unemployment and inflation-in explaining equity returns. A three-factor asset pricing model consisting of the market factor, the labor market tightness factor, and the inflation factor derived from this augmented search model captures large variations of stock returns in the cross-section. Agents demand negative risk premiums for labor market tightness via cash flow risks and positive premiums for the personal consumption expenditure index through discount rate risks.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了一个包含劳动异质性和消费价格冲击的一般均衡搜索模型，用于解释观察到的股权溢价变异性。通过从贝弗里奇曲线推导劳动力市场紧张度因子，从菲利普斯曲线推导通胀因子，构建了一个包含市场因子、劳动力市场紧张度因子和通胀因子的三因子资产定价模型，能够捕捉股票横截面收益的大幅变动。
AI.research_question: 如何通过扩展的一般均衡搜索模型来解释股权溢价的变异性？
AI.motivation: 现有模型难以充分解释股权溢价的变异性，需要纳入劳动力市场动态和通胀因素来改进资产定价模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡搜索模型、贝弗里奇曲线、菲利普斯曲线、三因子资产定价模型
AI.method: 扩展一般均衡搜索模型，从贝弗里奇曲线推导劳动力市场紧张度因子，从菲利普斯曲线推导通胀因子，构建三因子资产定价模型
AI.findings: 三因子模型能够捕捉股票横截面收益的大幅变动；投资者对劳动力市场紧张度要求负风险溢价（通过现金流风险），对个人消费支出指数要求正风险溢价（通过折现率风险）
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动力市场动态和通胀因素纳入资产定价理论，扩展了一般均衡搜索模型在金融领域的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更准确的资产定价工具，帮助理解不同风险因子的定价机制

title: A Mudskipper-Inspired Soft Robot for Precision Agriculture in Egypt's Northern Nile Delta

detail.title: A Mudskipper-Inspired Soft Robot for Precision Agriculture in Egypt's Northern Nile Delta
detail.abstract: Agriculture in Egypt’s Nile Delta is increasingly threatened by environmental stressors such as soil salinization, waterlogging, and pH imbalances, which significantly reduce crop productivity and impact food security (Elshaer et al., 2021; Hassan Mohamed, 2020). Conventional farming techniques and mechanized soil monitoring systems often prove ineffective in the swampy, salt-affected landscapes of the northern Delta (Abdel-Mottaleb et al., 2019). To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel mudskipper-inspired soft robotic system that integrates biomimicry principles with IoT-enabled sensing technologies for real-time, minimally invasive soil condition monitoring and remediation. The robot’s soft, servo-actuated limbs enable adaptive locomotion across delicate crops and saturated soils without causing damage, while embedded sensors continuously measure salinity and pH levels to inform precision agriculture practices (Zhang et al., 2022). By providing accurate spatial and temporal soil data, this system supports targeted interventions to enhance soil fertility, increase agricultural yields, and promote sustainable livelihoods in vulnerable Nile Delta communities. The approach demonstrates the potential of soft robotics combined with environmental sensing to overcome limitations of traditional methods and offers a scalable solution for similar coastal agricultural regions facing climate-driven salinity challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受弹涂鱼启发的软体机器人系统，结合仿生学原理和物联网传感技术，用于尼罗河三角洲土壤条件的实时监测和修复，以应对土壤盐渍化、水涝和pH失衡等环境压力。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种能够有效监测和修复尼罗河三角洲盐渍化土壤的软体机器人系统？
AI.motivation: 埃及尼罗河三角洲农业面临土壤盐渍化、水涝和pH失衡等环境压力，传统耕作技术和机械化土壤监测系统在沼泽化、盐渍化景观中效果不佳，严重影响作物产量和粮食安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仿生学原理（弹涂鱼运动机制）、软体机器人技术、物联网传感技术、精准农业理论。
AI.method: 开发受弹涂鱼启发的软体机器人系统，配备伺服驱动软体肢体和嵌入式传感器，实现自适应运动和对盐度、pH值的连续监测。
AI.findings: 该系统能够在脆弱作物和饱和土壤上进行自适应运动而不造成损害，同时提供准确的空间和时间土壤数据，支持精准农业干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 将仿生学原理与软体机器人技术相结合，为环境监测和修复提供了新的理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，用于提高土壤肥力、增加农业产量，并促进尼罗河三角洲脆弱社区的可持续生计，适用于面临气候驱动盐度挑战的类似沿海农业区域。

title: Breaking the Transactional Symmetry: Towards an Asymmetric Monetary Architecture for Regenerative Economies

detail.title: Breaking the Transactional Symmetry: Towards an Asymmetric Monetary Architecture for Regenerative Economies

declarations.funderStatement: This research received no dedicated funding beyond the ADEME “Low-Tech and Territorial Resilience” call for commons (2020).

detail.abstract: Our societies face a structural contradiction: every act of environmental sobriety or social care, vital for planetary limits and social foundations, is still recorded by our economic instruments as a loss of wealth. Current monetary systems, inherited from the Neolithic era, recognise only private value. Consequently, within transactions, the preservation of common goods (climate, biodiversity, social cohesion...) appears as a cost, never as a creation of wealth. This paper proposes a hypothesis for overcoming that accounting lock-in: the emergence of monetary systems able to recognise, within each transaction, the collective value created or destroyed. We name these currencies Common Good Units (UBiC for “Unité de Bien Commun” in french). Unlike conventional “private-good” currencies, UBiC intentionally break transactional symmetry: when an activity benefits the commons, new money is issued; when it harms them, money is destroyed. We outline the theoretical rationale, preliminary simulations, and research-action pathways for testing this hypothesis, addressing inflation control, convertibility, and banking compatibility. We invite the scientific community to investigate whether aligning private incentives with collective interests can, through the very architecture of money, render regenerative behaviours economically profitable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型货币系统——公共物品单位（UBiC），旨在解决当前经济体系中环境保护和社会关怀行为被记录为财富损失的结构性矛盾。UBiC通过打破交易对称性，在有益于公共物品的活动中发行货币，在损害公共物品的活动中销毁货币，从而将私人激励与集体利益对齐。
AI.research_question: 如何通过货币系统架构使再生行为在经济上有利可图，从而将私人激励与集体利益对齐？
AI.motivation: 当前社会面临结构性矛盾：环境保护和社会关怀等对地球界限和社会基础至关重要的行为，在经济工具中被记录为财富损失。传统货币系统只承认私人价值，公共物品的维护被视为成本而非财富创造。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共物品单位（UBiC）理论框架，打破交易对称性，在有益于公共物品的活动中发行货币，在损害公共物品的活动中销毁货币。
AI.method: 理论论证、初步模拟和研究行动路径，涉及通货膨胀控制、可兑换性和银行兼容性。
AI.findings: 提出UBiC货币系统能够通过货币架构本身使再生行为在经济上有利可图。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了能够识别交易中集体价值创造或破坏的货币系统理论，突破了传统货币只承认私人价值的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为测试这一假设提供了研究路径，可能为解决环境和社会问题提供新的经济工具，使保护公共物品的行为在经济上获得回报。

title: Injury and Accountability in Cyberspace: Applying Lessig's Four-Restraints Framework to the Question of Mandatory Identity Disclosure in Ghana
affiliations: Public Relations Ghana

detail.title: Injury and Accountability in Cyberspace: Applying Lessig's Four-Restraints Framework to the Question of Mandatory Identity Disclosure in Ghana

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable.

detail.abstract: Ghana's 1992 Constitution guarantees the rights to privacy and free speech, both of which are vital for personal liberty and democratic participation. The Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), reinforces these rights by safeguarding online identities, thereby fostering cyberspace anonymity. While anonymity protects privacy and encourages free expression, it also enables harmful conduct, including the dissemination of misinformation, cyberbullying, and other unlawful activities. Cyberlibertarians, such as John Perry Barlow, argue against all forms of governmental intervention in cyberspace; however, cyberpaternalists like Lawrence Lessig believe that the unique characteristics of the internet make it possible for the law to intervene. Using Lessig's four-restraints framework-law, markets, architecture, and norms-this paper analyses the tension between injury prevention and rights protection in Ghana's digital space. It concludes that a mandatory identity disclosure is not a necessary policy response to address cyberspace injury and accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了加纳数字空间中匿名性带来的权利保护与伤害预防之间的张力，基于Lessig的四重约束框架，认为强制性身份披露并非解决网络伤害和问责的必要政策回应。
AI.research_question: 在加纳数字空间中，如何平衡匿名性带来的权利保护与防止网络伤害之间的张力？强制性身份披露是否是必要的政策回应？
AI.motivation: 加纳宪法保障隐私权和言论自由权，数据保护法强化了这些权利并促进网络匿名性。但匿名性既保护权利又可能助长有害行为，需要探讨如何平衡这一矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lawrence Lessig的四重约束框架：法律、市场、架构和规范，以及网络自由主义者与网络家长主义者之间的理论分歧。
AI.method: 理论分析框架应用，基于Lessig的四重约束理论分析加纳数字空间中的权利保护与伤害预防问题。
AI.findings: 强制性身份披露并非解决网络伤害和问责的必要政策回应，可以通过其他方式平衡权利保护与伤害预防。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Lessig的四重约束框架应用于加纳数字空间治理，为网络匿名性与责任平衡提供了理论分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳政策制定者提供了替代强制性身份披露的治理方案，有助于在保护数字权利的同时有效应对网络伤害问题。

title: Large Moves in the Foreign Exchange Market
affiliations: University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS), University of Cambridge - Judge Business School, University of Cambridge - Judge Business School and  Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

detail.title: Large Moves in the Foreign Exchange Market
detail.abstract: The timing of large currency moves - say three-standard deviations events - is often considered random. In contrast, we show that a non-trivial proportion of large moves in exchange rates is predictable in real time via the slope of the term structure of option-implied volatility (IV). Specifically, the difference between short-term and longer-term IVs is a significant and robust predictor of large currency returns in absolute value. This predictive relationship is exploitable in a trading strategy that buys strangles when the term structure of IV is sufficiently inverted, to profit from the subsequent realization of such large moves.

AI.tldr: 本文发现期权隐含波动率期限结构的斜率能够实时预测汇率的大幅变动，特别是当短期隐含波动率高于长期时，预示着未来可能出现大幅汇率波动，这一关系可用于交易策略获利。
AI.research_question: 期权隐含波动率期限结构的斜率是否能够预测汇率的大幅变动？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为汇率大幅变动的时间是随机的，但作者希望通过期权市场信息来挑战这一观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于期权定价理论和隐含波动率期限结构理论，探讨波动率期限结构斜率对汇率大幅变动的预测能力。
AI.method: 使用期权隐含波动率数据，分析短期与长期隐含波动率差异对汇率大幅变动的预测关系，并构建交易策略进行验证。
AI.findings: 短期与长期隐含波动率差异是汇率大幅变动的显著且稳健的预测因子，当期限结构足够倒挂时，买入跨式期权策略能够从后续的大幅波动中获利。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了汇率大幅变动随机性的传统观点，证明了期权市场信息对汇率大幅变动的预测价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的交易策略，投资者可以利用隐含波动率期限结构信息来预测和利用汇率大幅波动机会。

title: Exploring the Tapestry of Tourism: A Comparative Study of a Selection of Balkan Countries
affiliations: University of Shkodra

detail.title: Exploring the Tapestry of Tourism: A Comparative Study of a Selection of Balkan Countries
detail.abstract: This study employs time series analysis to examine the factors influencing fluctuations in tourist arrivals within a certain timeframe (1993-2023) across a chosen set of Western Balkan nations. The countries that have been chosen for this study are Albania, Croatia, Montenegro, and Greece. These nations exhibit distinct attributes in terms of their socioeconomic development patterns; nonetheless, they share commonalities in terms of their coastal topography and cultural heritage influences. In this study, GMM models will be employed to analyze the relationship between the number of tourist arrivals and international tourism receipts. The models will incorporate various independent variables, including GDP growth rate, consumer price index, exchange rate, transportation costs, and other pertinent factors associated with tourism infrastructure. Based on our estimation results, we have observed small variations among countries, indicating a relatively low amount of price elasticity. Nevertheless, when considering Balkan countries, it is shown that income level and currency rates hold greater significance.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用时间序列分析探讨1993-2023年间西巴尔干国家旅游人数波动的影响因素，发现收入水平和汇率对巴尔干国家旅游需求的影响比价格弹性更重要。
AI.research_question: 影响西巴尔干国家旅游人数波动的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 西巴尔干国家在海岸地形和文化遗产方面具有相似性，但社会经济发模式存在差异，需要研究这些国家旅游需求的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游需求理论，价格弹性理论，收入效应理论
AI.method: 使用GMM模型分析旅游人数与国际旅游收入的关系，纳入GDP增长率、消费者价格指数、汇率、交通成本等自变量
AI.findings: 各国之间存在较小差异，价格弹性相对较低；但对巴尔干国家而言，收入水平和汇率更为重要
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对西巴尔干地区旅游需求决定因素的理解，验证了收入效应在旅游需求中的重要性

detail.title: Leverage Volatility Risk *
detail.abstract: We show that time variations in intermediary leverage volatility affect asset prices. Leverage volatility is a negatively priced source of risk. At the firm level, exposure to leverage volatility risk inversely predicts future returns, yielding a spread across decile portfolios of 5.2 (4.4) percent annually when measuring intermediary leverage with security broker-dealer (primary-dealer) data. When leverage volatility is high in recessions, equity term premiums increase, and the intermediary expects low returns in the future, leading to negatively expected changes in equity yields. Thus, the slope of the equity yield curve is potentially negative in busts and vice versa.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现中介机构杠杆波动率是资产价格的负向定价风险因子。杠杆波动率越高，预期未来回报越低，在衰退期尤其明显，导致股权收益率曲线斜率可能为负。

title: The Supreme Court Should Clarify How to Apply Loper Bright in the Patent Law Case of Lynk Labs, Inc. v. Samsung Co. Ltd.

detail.title: The Supreme Court Should Clarify How to Apply Loper Bright in the Patent Law Case of Lynk Labs, Inc. v. Samsung Co. Ltd.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: When the Supreme Court issued Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo last year-squarely rejecting Chevron and instructing courts to independently interpret statutes-it marked a watershed moment in administrative law. Yet nearly a year later, the Court has provided virtually no guidance on how Loper Bright should be applied. That silence leaves courts, practitioners, and those of us training future lawyers without real-world examples to illuminate this new interpretive landscape. That is why I submitted an amicus brief in Lynk Labs, Inc. v. Samsung Co. Ltd., urging the Court to grant review. Although the case arises in the patent arena, it presents a far more universal question: whether lower courts may quietly sidestep Loper Bright by elevating agency policy preferences over statutory text.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了最高法院在Loper Bright案中推翻Chevron原则后的应用困境，指出法院缺乏实际指导，并通过Lynk Labs案探讨下级法院是否可能规避Loper Bright原则。
AI.research_question: 下级法院是否可能通过将机构政策偏好置于法规文本之上来规避Loper Bright案确立的原则？
AI.motivation: 最高法院在Loper Bright案中推翻Chevron原则后，近一年来未提供实际应用指导，导致法院、从业者和法律教育者缺乏现实案例来理解这一新的解释格局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政法中的司法审查原则、法规解释理论、机构遵从原则的演变
AI.method: 通过分析Lynk Labs, Inc. v. Samsung Co. Ltd.案例，探讨Loper Bright原则在专利领域的应用问题
AI.findings: 尽管Loper Bright案确立了法院应独立解释法规的原则，但下级法院可能通过将机构政策偏好置于法规文本之上来规避这一原则
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对后Chevron时代司法审查理论的理解，探讨了法规解释原则在实际应用中的挑战
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院、法律从业者和法律教育者提供了理解Loper Bright原则实际应用的案例参考，有助于推动该原则的准确实施

title: Pricing abnormal weather risks in Chinese stock market
affiliations: South China University of Technology and South China University of Technology

detail.title: Pricing abnormal weather risks in Chinese stock market
detail.abstract: We construct six monthly abnormal weather indicators by employing physical weather data of temperature, humidity, wind speed, precipitation, sunshine hours and sky coverage in China. We compute the abnormal weather betas to proxy for abnormal weather risks and investigate the pricing effects of these risks in the Chinese stock market. We find a low abnormal weather beta premium in the cross-section, i.e., stocks with high betas to changes in the abnormal weather index significantly underperform those with low betas by 0.13% to 0.57% per month on a risk-adjusted basis. In particular, the low abnormal weather beta premiums of temperature, sunshine hours, and sky coverage are significant over the subsequent six months. The further analyses suggest that the abnormal weather betas exhibit persistent long-term predictive power and have significant explanatory power for size, value, and long-term reversal anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了六个月度异常天气指标，通过计算异常天气beta来代理异常天气风险，并研究这些风险在中国股市中的定价效应。研究发现存在低异常天气beta溢价，即高beta股票在风险调整后每月显著跑输低beta股票0.13%至0.57%。温度、日照时数和云量覆盖的异常天气beta溢价在后续六个月中尤为显著。
AI.research_question: 异常天气风险在中国股市中是否存在定价效应？
AI.motivation: 研究天气风险对资产定价的影响，特别是在中国股市这一重要新兴市场中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论和天气风险定价理论，构建异常天气风险指标。
AI.method: 使用中国物理天气数据构建六个月度异常天气指标，计算异常天气beta，并进行横截面回归分析。
AI.findings: 存在显著的异常天气beta溢价，高beta股票表现较差，温度、日照时数和云量覆盖的beta溢价在六个月内持续显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了天气风险定价理论，证实异常天气风险在中国股市中具有定价效应，并解释了部分市场异象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供天气风险管理的参考，帮助识别受天气风险影响的股票投资策略。

title: A Review of Theoretical and Empirical Models of Sovereign Debt
affiliations: University of York

detail.title: A Review of Theoretical and Empirical Models of Sovereign Debt
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how unexpected US monetary policy shocks affect sovereign risk and macroeconomic dynamics in Latin American emerging markets, combining theoretical modelling and empirical analysis. I develop a two-period sovereign default model that incorporates domestic households, government borrowing, and default decisions under financial constraints. The model extends existing frameworks by introducing a dual liquidity structure and linking default probabilities endogenously to international interest rates, thereby capturing the transmission of external financial shocks. Within this framework, a contractionary US monetary policy shock raises sovereign risk, increases lending rates, reduces bank credit to the corporate sector, and ultimately depresses industrial production. Empirically, I employ the orthogonalized US monetary policy surprise measure as an exogenous variable in panel regressions and a dynamic panel model covering Brazil, Chile, and Colombia. Results show that tighter US monetary policy increases sovereign bond yield spreads, reduces government bond values, and adversely affects financial and macroeconomic conditions. Moreover, the analysis highlights the role of investor composition: greater foreign participation in domestic bond markets mitigates the spread response to monetary shocks, suggesting a stabilising effect of international investors. By integrating theoretical and empirical perspectives, this study contributes to the sovereign debt literature in two ways. First, it provides a structural explanation for the mechanisms through which global monetary tightening transmits to emerging markets. Second, it offers new evidence on the interaction between external shocks, sovereign risk, and financial frictions in Latin America, yielding relevant insights for policymakers concerned with financial stability and external vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论建模和实证分析，研究了美国意外货币政策冲击对拉美新兴市场主权风险和宏观经济的影响。研究发现紧缩性美国货币政策会提高主权风险、增加贷款利率、减少银行信贷，最终抑制工业生产。
AI.research_question: 美国意外货币政策冲击如何影响拉美新兴市场的主权风险和宏观经济动态？
AI.motivation: 理解全球货币政策收紧向新兴市场传导的机制，以及外部冲击、主权风险和金融摩擦之间的相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个包含国内家庭、政府借贷和金融约束下违约决策的两期主权违约模型，引入了双重流动性结构并将违约概率内生地与国际利率联系起来。
AI.method: 结合理论建模和实证分析，使用正交化美国货币政策意外指标作为外生变量，在面板回归和动态面板模型中覆盖巴西、智利和哥伦比亚的数据。
AI.findings: 紧缩性美国货币政策会增加主权债券收益率利差、降低政府债券价值，并对金融和宏观经济条件产生不利影响。投资者构成分析显示，外国参与度越高，对货币政策冲击的利差反应越小。
AI.theory_contributions: 为全球货币政策收紧向新兴市场传导的机制提供了结构性解释，深化了对主权债务理论的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关注金融稳定性和外部脆弱性的政策制定者提供了相关见解，特别是在拉美地区外部冲击、主权风险和金融摩擦相互作用方面的新证据。

title: Towards Credible Corporate Net-Zero Commitments? On the Role of Unfair Commercial Practices Law in Contesting Global Value Chain Greenwashing
affiliations: Tilburg Law School

detail.title: Towards Credible Corporate Net-Zero Commitments? On the Role of Unfair Commercial Practices Law in Contesting Global Value Chain Greenwashing

declarations.funderStatement: I wish to acknowledge the funding provided for this project under the Incentive Grant Scheme of the Dutch Government 'Stimuleringsbeurs' for the project ‘Regulating Risk in the Age of Global Value Chains’. For more information, please visit (https://research.tilburguniversity.edu/en/persons/paul-verbruggen/projects/).

detail.abstract:
Corporate net-zero commitments are voluntary, forward-looking statements regarding a company's public commitment to reduce greenhouse gas emissions along its global value chain (GVC). These commitments are part of a wider set of strategies that aim at reducing the environmental impact of business operations in GVCs. Whether this particular strategy of greening GVCs can meet that goal fundamentally depends on the credibility of these commitments. Without it, critics say, the pledges amount to nothing less than corporate greenwashing. In this Chapter, I discuss the various credibility concerns of corporate net-zero commitments to identify and critically analyse the potential of unfair commercial practices laws to contest this form of GVC greenwashing. By focusing the analysis on the European legal framework, I demonstrate that such laws offer important relative benefits over other domains of private law in making the corporate commitments credible. They complement and reinforce other public and private regulatory efforts to ensure the adequacy and integrity of these pledges. Unfair commercial practices law therefore constitutes an important legal strategy for regulating sustainability in GVCs, one that corporations in the chain need to recon with when communicating net-zero targets to downstream market actors.

Forthcoming in: Debadatta Bose, Anne Lafarre, Ricardo Garcia Anton, Bas Rombouts and Paul Verbruggen (eds), Cambridge Handbook of Law and Responsible Business: Legal Strategies for Sustainability in Global Value Chains, Cambridge University Press 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了企业净零承诺的可信度问题，分析了不公平商业实践法律在应对全球价值链绿色漂洗方面的潜力，特别关注欧洲法律框架。

title: Automated Ball-Strike System(ABS) and Shift Ban: An Event Study Analysis of the 2024 KBO Rule Changes on Player Performance
affiliations: Dankook University and Pusan National University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Automated Ball-Strike System(ABS) and Shift Ban: An Event Study Analysis of the 2024 KBO Rule Changes on Player Performance
detail.abstract: This study investigates the causal impact of the 2024 rule changes in the Korea Baseball Organization (KBO)-specifically the introduction of the Automated Ball-Strike System (ABS) and the prohibition of defensive shifts-on batter performance. Using daily game log data from 2022 to 2025, we employ a fixed-effects model controlling for player, team, and seasonal seasonality to estimate the monthly effects of these policy interventions. Our event study results reveal a significant structural shift in plate discipline and outcomes. We find a robust "trade-off" effect: the implementation of ABS is associated with a statistically significant increase in strikeout rates (SO%) and a decrease in walk rates (BB%), suggesting a stricter and more consistent strike zone. However, despite the rise in strikeouts, overall batting averages (AVG) remained stable or increased, primarily driven by a rise in Batting Average on Balls In Play (BABIP) attributed to the defensive shift ban. Furthermore, we identify a pronounced lateseason surge in offensive metrics in the post-policy years, indicating an interaction between rule changes and pitcher fatigue in September and October.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了2024年KBO引入自动好球带系统和禁止防守布阵对击球员表现的因果影响。研究发现政策实施产生了"权衡效应"：ABS导致三振率上升、保送率下降，而防守布阵禁令则提高了击球率。
AI.research_question: 2024年KBO规则变更（自动好球带系统和防守布阵禁令）对击球员表现有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 了解棒球规则变化对比赛结果和球员表现的实际影响，为体育政策评估提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政策干预评估理论，运用事件研究法和固定效应模型分析规则变化的结构性影响。
AI.method: 使用2022-2025年每日比赛数据，采用固定效应模型控制球员、球队和季节性因素，估计政策干预的月度效应。
AI.findings: 1) ABS实施导致三振率显著上升、保送率下降；2) 防守布阵禁令使击球率保持稳定或上升，主要源于BABIP提高；3) 政策实施后赛季末出现进攻指标激增现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了棒球规则变化的"权衡效应"，证明了政策干预与球员疲劳的交互作用，丰富了体育政策评估理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为棒球联盟规则制定提供实证依据，帮助球队调整训练和战术策略，为球员表现评估提供新视角。

title: Student Debt and the Cinderella Effect
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Department of Finance, Pennsylvania State University - Department of Finance, University of Calgary - Finance and

detail.title: Student Debt and the Cinderella Effect
detail.abstract: Unexpected intercollegiate athletic success generates a variety of changes at universities -- including increased salience and status of sports-oriented activities among students, known colloquially as the "Cinderella effect". By linking data on athletic contest outcomes, betting lines, student debt default rates, and post-college earnings data, we find that Cinderella events disrupt human capital development among incumbent students and adversely affect their financial outcomes. Following such events, treated students exhibit higher default rates and lower earnings. This effect strengthens with treatment exposure (results are larger for freshmen than seniors) and is concentrated in low-ranked universities. These institutions show no changes in revenues or expenditures, suggesting that resource-driven explanations are unlikely to be the primary driver. In contrast, students at high-ranked universities have marginally lower default rates and higher earnings, as these schools receive more applications, increase selectivity, and have marginally higher revenues and expenditures. Overall, our results suggest that athletic success shifts students' preferences away from academic focus. More broadly, our results show that university environment affects human capital development, as distinct from selection effects that reflect assortive matching between students and universities.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现大学体育意外成功（"灰姑娘效应"）会分散学生对学业的关注，导致学生债务违约率上升和毕业后收入下降，这种负面影响在低排名大学中尤为明显。
